**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 57 **Trigger** Your size increases due to a [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effect. --- The physical growth of your transformation is a spectacle that shakes foes to their core. Each enemy smaller than your new size within 30 feet of you must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. **Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Failure** The creature becomes [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76).
**Critical Failure** The creature becomes frightened 2, and you can push it up to 10 feet from you. This is [forced movement](/Rules.aspx?ID=451).
name: Towering Transformation
